The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) prints a SIX-VALUE list on the form itself: 12 Tarjeta de identidad, 13 Cedula de ciudadania, 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Cedula de extranjeria, 31 NIT, 41 Pasaporte. That is NARROWER than the electronic payroll list at Annex table 5.2.1, which also carries 11 Record civil, 42 Foreign identity document, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais and 91 NUIP. An employee holding a PEP or a PPT therefore has NO exact code here. Rule to be set at implementation: the code to output for a PEP or PPT holder. SOURCE: the employee master holds one document-number field per document type ('National ID', 'Identity Card', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'Citizenship Card ID') and no document-type field, and more than one of them may be populated for the same employee. The engine must store an explicit Employee.Document_Type for the document actually certified in casilla 25, never infer it from which field is filled. The mapping of the employee master document fields to the Form 220 codes is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation (e.g. 'Citizenship Card ID' -> 13 and 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> 22; 'National ID' and 'Identity Card' have no direct Form 220 code).

Identification number exactly as it appears on the identity document of the type in casilla 24, held as text (no dots, hyphens or spaces). Join key to the electronic payroll NIE045, to PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 4 and to Format 2276 numeral 2. SOURCE: the document-number field of the employee master that matches the document type in casilla 24 ('Citizenship Card ID', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'National ID' or 'Identity Card'), selected through Employee.Document_Type. Do NOT use the internal employee number ('Employee ID' / 'ID Number'): it is a payroll key, not an identity document. The casilla is mandatory: a blank document number is rejected as a data error. PAYEES OUTSIDE THE EMPLOYEE MASTER (pension payees and other non-employee payees): casilla 25 and the split names of casillas 26-29 are taken from the identity source configured at implementation for that payee population (a configuration parameter, e.g. the pensioner master), which must hold the document type, the document number and the four name parts. Where a pension is paid to a beneficiary other than the pensioner, see casilla 50.
Second surname. Not mandatory here, in contrast with the electronic payroll where it is use=required (CO-GAP-07).

First day of the certified period, output as AAAA MM DD. Normally 1 January of the tax year, but the start date of the employment relationship where the employee joined during the year. Bidirectional pair with casilla 31. SOURCE: Master Data field 'Hire Date' (format DD-MM-YYYY, converted to AAAA MM DD) - the start of the employment relationship current in the tax year. The master-data date field used is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation (default 'Hire Date'); 'Original Hire Date' (DD-MM-YYYY) and 'Adjusted Service Date' (YYYY-MM-DD) refer to earlier or adjusted service and do not define the certified period.

City or municipality where the withholding was practised (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024) - not necessarily the employer's registered domicile, and not necessarily the employee's place of work. It is a withholding-agent parameter (an employer setting supplied at implementation, held as the five-digit DIVIPOLA code of the place of withholding), not an employee attribute. Output the municipality NAME, in upper case without accents, that corresponds to the DANE code of casillas 34 and 35, so that the three casillas always describe the same place.

Total salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period to a resident natural person whose income derives from an employment or statutory relationship. The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. SOURCE: salary wage types 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. BONUSES: HABITUAL bonuses are salary and are certified here - 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus and 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA; NON-HABITUAL bonuses are certified in casilla 46 - 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA is routed by the habitual / non-habitual flag held on the wage-type-to-casilla table (casilla 36 where habitual, casilla 46 where not). The wage-type attribute 'Salary Payment Indicator' must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus), which is certified in casilla 42, and on per diems (62805-62808), which are always certified in casilla 43, and on the leave payouts 79405-79419 (marriage, maternity, paternity, sick-leave, bereavement, paid and jury leave payouts); and it is absent from the bonus wage types 62229, 62224 and 62202 listed above. The engine holds an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table, a configuration parameter supplied at implementation; every earning wage type is assigned. Rule to be set at implementation: the casilla of the leave payouts 79405-79419 and of salary paid abroad to expatriates (25830 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country). PERIOD: sum the payments made from 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.

Payments made in electronic or paper service vouchers, cheques, cards or vales - for fuel, school supplies, footwear and clothing, or any other purpose. Deductible for the employer and income for the employee. THREE EXPLICIT NOTES in the instruction guide: (1) INCLUDE meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month; (2) do NOT include meal payments for an employee earning up to 310 UVT - those go to casilla 38; (3) do NOT include anything already reported in casilla 36. SOURCE: in-kind benefits paid to third parties are booked as informative earning wage types ('Inf.') offset by an equal informative deduction - e.g. 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079 offset by 21115 Meal Allowance Inf. Deduction-2644 - and the same pattern applies to 65811 Gym Allowance Inf.-6969, 65809 / 65839 Optical Allowance Inf, 65812 Text Books Allowance - Inf-6971, 65801 / 65814 / 65815 / 65831 Private Health Insurance Inf and 65817 / 65837 Life Insurance-Inf. The earning side is the certified value; the offsetting deduction wage types are payroll mechanics and are not themselves casilla values. The meal item 65818 is subject to the 41 UVT / 310 UVT test of casillas 37-38, applied month by month: in a month in which the employee's salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole 65818 amount is certified here; in a month in which it does not, nothing is certified here and the excess over 41 UVT goes to casilla 38 (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024; ET art. 387-1). Rule to be set at implementation: the casilla (37, 38, 46 or none) of each of the other in-kind benefit wage types listed above, in the wage-type-to-casilla table.

Work-income payments not falling in any other casilla. Use sparingly: DIAN expects a concept with a dedicated casilla to use that casilla. Certified here (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024): (a) NON-HABITUAL BONUSES - 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up; habitual bonuses are salary and go to casilla 36; 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA is routed by the habitual / non-habitual flag of the wage-type-to-casilla table (casilla 36 where habitual, casilla 46 where not). (b) PAYMENTS TO RETIREES THAT ARE NOT A PENSION - 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV-6795, 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya-6796, 62115 Retirement Allowance, 62830 Pensioner Allowance-6794 and 62155 Medical Plan - Healthcare Insurance (EPS ) Pensioner- PMI Offset Compensation; the pension itself (62154 Monthly Retired  Pension-6798 and 62153 Additional Retirement Pension) is certified in casilla 50, never here (see casilla 50). The engine holds an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table (a configuration parameter supplied at implementation); no earning wage type may be left unassigned. Rule to be set at implementation: the casilla (36, 42, 46 or not certified) of the earning wage types with no dedicated casilla: 62131 Scholarship-6861, 62700 School Allowance-6839, 62590 Marriage Allowance-6801, 62591 Child Birth Allowance-6002, 62112 Family Burial Allowance-6319, 62811 Health Allowance-6473, 62523 Transportation Allowance CLA- 2008, 62540 Housing Allowance Domestic Relocation-2087, 62310 Expat allowance 5526, 62320 Leasing Expat Allowance Inf-5524, 65821 Expatriation Package for Inbounds, 65800 Stock awards (Vesting) - Informative-1004, 62138 Dividend payment (stock awards) -1003, 65803 Plan Institucional PROTECCION - Payment- 6785, 65804 Plan Institucional PROTECCION - IC Bonus, 62180 / 62181 Severance/Layoff Payment (dismissal indemnity) and 62837 Leave payout.

Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER: pensions of jubilacion, vejez or invalidez (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Pensions paid directly by the employer are in scope and are certified here. SOURCE: the pension wage types of the wage-type-to-casilla table: 62154 Monthly Retired  Pension-6798 (the monthly pension) and 62153 Additional Retirement Pension (the additional pension instalments paid in June and December). Payments to retirees that are not a pension are certified in casilla 46, never here: 62151 Retirement Payment - PRV-6795, 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya-6796, 62115 Retirement Allowance, 62830 Pensioner Allowance-6794 and 62155 Medical Plan - Healthcare Insurance (EPS ) Pensioner- PMI Offset Compensation (see casilla 46). Pension payees are not in the employee master: their identification (casillas 24-29) comes from the pensioner identity source configured at implementation (see casilla 25). Rule to be set at implementation: to whom the certificate is issued where the pension is paid to a beneficiary other than the pensioner (substitute pensioner or third-party payee). Pensioner health and solidarity deductions (21645 / 21646 / 21647, 21643) feed casillas 53 and 54, and the withholding on pension income (21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799) feeds casilla 60.

Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1 and DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.22.41. Shares the ET art. 336 40% / 1,340-UVT annual cap with AFC and AVC. SOURCE: wage types 25811 Pension Voluntaria Porvenir (FVOL), 25812 Pension Voluntaria Proteccion (FVOL), 25813 Pension Voluntaria Skandia (FVOL), 25814 Pensiones Voluntarias Metlife (FVOL), 25815 Dafuturo (FVOL) and 25823 Pension Voluntaria colfondos (FVOL). Rule to be set at implementation: whether the institutional-plan wage types 21210 / 21211 Plan Institucional PROTECCION and 25820 / 25821 Plan Institucional PROTECCION - IC Bonus are certified in casilla 56. Wage type 21193 Foncoltabaco voluntary contribution is a contribution to an employee fund, not to a pension fund, and is not certified here. Because several of these fund managers also run mandatory RAIS accounts, the engine must tag each voluntary contribution as RAIS (casilla 55) or voluntary fund (casilla 56); the tag is carried on the wage type.

THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING CASILLA. Total withholding at source ACTUALLY PRACTISED on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period; no hypothetical, theoretical or contingent amount is certified (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). Feeds casilla 75 together with casilla 74. Must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 for this employee, and the sum of casilla 60 across all employees must reconcile to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93 - allowing for the rounding conventions. SOURCE: the withholding practised is wage type 2552 Income Tax (employee) plus 21129 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations- 541T (a separate deduction on termination payments, which can coexist with 2552 in the same month) and 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799. Wage types 21330 Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical) and 25834 Hypothetical Witholding Tax  - IC Foreign Country are notional, not withholding practised, and are NOT certified; the same exclusion applies to every wage type that computes a theoretical, hypothetical or contingent withholding. Rule to be set at implementation: whether 25832 / 65832 Witholding Tax on Stock awards and 25833 Witholding Tax  - IC Local Country carry withholding actually practised on this employee's income and are certified here. Only the withholding actually deducted is certified: a comparison result computed without the contribution depuration, and any contingent withholding derived from it, is not part of 2552 and is not certified. Sum January to December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.

THIS LIST IS NARROWER THAN THE ELECTRONIC PAYROLL LIST at Annex table 5.2.1, which also carries 11 Record civil, 42 Foreign identity document, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais and 91 NUIP. There is NO code here for a PEP holder and none for a PPT holder (Decree 216 of 2021) - which is the document the large majority of regularised Venezuelan migrants now hold. The code to output for these holders is set at implementation (see casilla 24).

The amount DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen fund by 14 February under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99, certified in the tax year of the deposit (ET art. 27 num. 3). Format 2276 numeral 19 - NOT 20. Must reconcile to CO-SEVERANCE SAVINGS-006.
Annual cap on the 25% exempt income. Mercans apportions at 65.8333 UVT per month - see scope_manifest CO-GAP-05.
Annual cap on deductions plus exempt income, alongside the 40% limit. Mercans apportions at 111.6667 UVT per month - see CO-GAP-05.
